title: Rush Charge Basis by Amount of Work — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Rate Card
content:
On a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket accepted with rush service, the rush charge basis depends on the work on the ticket, and exactly one of three forms applies.

| Work on the ticket | Rush charge basis |
|---|---|
| Three or more operation charges | per operation: the number of operation charges multiplied by 30.00 USD |
| One or two operation charges, and a rush-fee operation base under 80.00 USD | a flat rush basis of 25.00 USD |
| One or two operation charges, and a rush-fee operation base of 80.00 USD or more | the class's rush fee percentage for the ticket's service class of the rush-fee operation base |

**Terms used.** An operation charge is a charge for one operation on the ticket; each counts once, whatever its price. A lined surcharge charge is not an operation charge and does not add to the count. The rush-fee operation base is the total of every operation charge and every lined surcharge charge booked on the ticket.

## The two thresholds, both sides

- **Count of operation charges, threshold 3.** Two operation charges: one of the two lower rows applies. Three operation charges: the per-operation row applies, whatever the base.
- **Base, threshold 80.00 USD (one or two operation charges only).** A base of 79.99 USD: flat 25.00 USD. A base of exactly 80.00 USD: the class's rush fee percentage of the base.

## Hypothetical cases

| Ticket | Operation charges | Rush-fee operation base | Rush charge basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 1 | 24.00 USD | 25.00 USD (flat) |
| B | 2 | 79.99 USD | 25.00 USD (flat) |
| C | 2 | 80.00 USD | the class's rush fee percentage of 80.00 USD; at a percentage of, say, 50 percent, 40.00 USD |
| D | 3 | 60.00 USD | 3 multiplied by 30.00, that is 90.00 USD |
| E | 4 | 310.00 USD | 4 multiplied by 30.00, that is 120.00 USD |
